_comment: Accepted differences, decided by a person. Every entry has an id and a reason; the parity report counts how often each fires.

ignoreSubtrees.reason: map tiles and markers come from a live tile server
third-party feed iframe content is not part of the app

listTolerance.reason: OS List renders rows progressively; the count at capture time depends on timing

ignoreStates.loading-firstframe: captured mid slide-in transition; checked by a person
ignoreStates.back-firstframe: view-cache restore timing; checked by a person

rules.reason: carousel slide position depends on time

pixel._comment: threshold: per-pixel colour distance (pixelmatch scale); maxRatio: share of the page; maxCellRatio: share of the worst 40px tile

appStartCalls.reason: calls the app makes on every app open; for states captured `via` another screen (states.json) the capture holds only the calls made after arriving, so these are not compared there unless the capture has them too
